review_candidates.title: Global Director of Accounting & Controlling (IFRS/GAAP)
review_candidates.description: Imagine this. You are building the accounting and controlling backbone behind a fast-growing aerospace and defence company operating across multiple countries, manufacturing sites, and legal entities. As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you will own the integrity of our group financial reporting, set the standard for IFRS and local GAAP compliance, and make sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, scalable, and audit-ready. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be the group's senior technical accounting authority and a key finance leader across the organization. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage accounting from a distance. You will set the agenda, challenge existing processes, solve complex accounting issues, and drive execution across a distributed international finance organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual group close across all consolidated entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting Own the group close calendar and drive execution across Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and regional finance teams Act as the senior escalation point for complex accounting and close issues, driving them to resolution without compromising reporting quality or timelines Coordinate consolidation adjustments, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and other group-level accounting activities Own and continuously strengthen internal accounting controls, policies, and their consistent application across the group Drive improvements to our ERP and finance systems landscape, including Microsoft Dynamics environments, IFRS and local GAAP configurations, regional VAT setups, transfer pricing, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation processes Own group-wide cost accounting standards and methodologies across manufacturing entities, including standard and actual costing, absorption, WIP, and variance analysis Lead the Operations Finance function through the Operations Finance Lead and ensure disciplined capture and reporting of manufacturing costs including labor, overhead, scrap, absorption, and WIP Own the variance bridge process and ensure significant deviations are understood, explained, and assigned to the right accountable teams across Manufacturing, Program Management, Procurement, and Finance Connect Cost Accounting, Operations, Manufacturing, and Program Management so operational drivers such as volume, yield, labor mix, and capacity utilization are reflected in forecasts and budgets Partner closely with FP&A to ensure accounting actuals, forecasts, and budgets remain methodologically aligned as the business scales Own accounting judgments related to inventory, WIP, and program cost capitalization under IAS 2 Govern the group chart of accounts and ensure it remains consistent, scalable, and aligned with consolidation and management reporting requirements Own balance sheet quality across the group, establishing clear standards for account ownership, reconciliations, substantiation, aging, suspense accounts, clearing accounts, and provisions Partner with FP&A and Treasury on working capital, provisions, capex accounting, and other balance sheet forecasting inputs Oversee AP and AR processes across the group, strengthening controls, segregation of duties, cash conversion, and sub-ledger reconciliation Drive DSO and DPO discipline and establish robust policies around credit control, payment terms, and dispute resolution Act as the primary management counterpart for external auditors across group and statutory audits Own audit timelines, PBC processes, technical accounting documentation, and the timely resolution of audit findings Ensure statutory financial statements are accurate and filed on time across jurisdictions in coordination with local teams and external advisors Support lender and investor diligence with accurate, audit-ready financial schedules and clear technical accounting narratives Standardize accounting processes and controls across entities and eliminate unnecessary manual workarounds as the organization grows Partner with IT and ERP teams to build scalable accounting, costing, consolidation, and reporting structures within systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Own group accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs, creating a consistent framework for control, onboarding, and training Build and develop a high-performing accounting and controlling organization across multiple European jurisdictions, setting clear expectations and creating accountability across direct and indirect teams Mentor Controllers and Accounting Managers across the group and act as the technical escalation point when complex accounting decisions need to be made What You'll Need 10+ years of progressive Accounting, Controlling, or Finance experience, including substantial responsibility within a multi-entity, multi-currency European environment Public Company Experience Is Required Deep technical knowledge of IFRS and strong familiarity with local GAAP requirements across European jurisdictions Demonstrated experience owning group accounting policies and making complex technical accounting judgments Proven experience leading group close and consolidation processes at significant scale, ideally within environments exceeding EUR 1 billion in revenue Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including standard and actual costing, variance analysis, absorption, inventory, and WIP Experience working closely with Manufacturing and Operations teams, with the ability to connect operational performance with financial outcomes Strong ERP experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, or an equivalent large-scale platform, including exposure to chart-of-accounts design, costing structures, consolidation, and finance transformation Experience leading geographically distributed finance teams and developing senior accounting and controlling professionals Excellent English communication skills, with additional European languages considered an advantage Experience within aerospace, defence, industrial manufacturing, or another regulated and program-driven environment is strongly preferred Experience with statutory reporting requirements across multiple European jurisdictions is a strong advantage Familiarity with program-based revenue recognition, government or institutional customers, and complex manufacturing environments is an advantage. Who You Are You combine technical accounting depth with the drive to get things done. You care about clean numbers, strong controls, and clear ownership, but you also understand that Finance needs to move at the speed of the business. You are comfortable being the person people turn to when the accounting answer is not obvious. You challenge assumptions, translate complex IFRS topics into practical decisions, and know when to go deep and when to move quickly. You think beyond the next close. You build processes, systems, and teams that can support a company as it grows across countries, manufacturing sites, and increasingly complex operations. You work naturally across Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Manufacturing, Operations, and leadership, and you are persistent about getting decisions and open issues to closure. Most importantly, you build capability around you. You develop strong teams, create accountability, and make sure critical accounting knowledge is embedded across the organization rather than concentrated in one person.

review_candidates.title: Freight Forwarder Air/Ocean
review_candidates.description: Over de organisatie Delmar International (Netherlands) B.V. is een intercontinentale zee- en luchtvracht expediteur die een hoog servicelevel hanteert voor haar klanten. Bij Delmar Nederland werk je samen met 30 professionals die samen de dagelijkse zee- en luchtvracht zendingen voor opdrachtgevers in binnen- en buitenland verzorgen en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Ons kantoor is gevestigd in Zevenaar en beschikt over een eigen warehouse & CFS. Delmar Nederland maakt deel uit van Delmar International, het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Montreal, Canada. Wereldwijd zijn er ruim 50 kantoren! Met ons gezamenlijke motto “Logistics made Simple” vereenvoudigen we het logistieke proces voor onze klanten. Door gebruik te maken van een wereldwijd netwerk, effectief samenwerken en moderne software biedt Delmar op maat gemaakte logistieke oplossingen. De communicatielijnen zijn kort en er heerst een informele sfeer, gecombineerd met een professionele instelling. Wij gaan graag een stap verder voor onze klanten. Wij zijn op zoek naar collega`s die dit ook nastreven. Wat ga je doen? Je komt te werken binnen het zee- of luchtvrachtteam, waar samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. Als freight forwarderben jij de spil in het volledige logistieke proces. Jij regelt het transport van begin tot eind en bent hét aanspreekpunt voor alle betrokken partijen, zoals klanten, buitenlandse kantoren en/of partners, rederijen, luchtvaartmaatschappijen, vervoerders en de douane. Je houdt overzicht, denkt vooruit en speelt proactief in op mogelijke knelpunten. Je zorgt voor een correcte en tijdige administratieve afhandeling van jouw dossier. Kortom: je coördineert het gehele logistieke traject van A tot Z. En het allerbelangrijkste: jij ontzorgt de klant volledig. Wat breng jij mee? Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding op MBO-of-HBO niveau. Affiniteit met logistiek is een pré, maar geen vereiste. Je hebt 0 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring. Je bent klantgericht, flexibel en hebt een proactieve instelling Je bent digitaal onderlegd en kan gestructureerd werken Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar weet ook wanneer je moet schakelen met collega`s Je bentsterk inNederlandse en Engelsecommunicatie, zowel mondeling alsschriftelijk Je bent bekend met het gebruik van het MS-office pakket (Word, Excel, Outlook, OneNote, etc.) en bij voorkeur ook ERP-pakketten (CargoWise) Om deze werkzaamheden goed uit te kunnen voeren, word je door ervaren collega’s ingewerkt en volg je eventuele vakspecifieke opleidingen. Uiteindelijk zul je veel vrijheid in je werk ervaren, waarin je altijd kan terugvallen op en overleggen met je collega`s. En wil je je op termijn verder ontwikkelen? Dan bieden wij je daar de mogelijkheden voor. Ons Aanbod Fulltime functie van 40 uur per week tijdens kantoortijden Een uitgebreide inwerkperiode door ervaren collega’s Mogelijkheid tot het volgen van vakspecifieke opleidingen Alle ruimte om je te ontwikkelen binnen dit mooie vakgebied Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheidin je werk Geniet van regionaal werken met weinig reistijd, gecombineerd met de allure, de mogelijkheden en de kennis van een grote internationale organisatie Een hecht team waarin je altijd kunt overleggen en terugvallen op collega’s Een moderne werkomgeving Marktconform salaris. Resultaatgerelateerde eindejaar bonus. Een premievrije pensioenregeling. 26vakantiedagen per jaar Een coulante reiskostenvergoeding Waarom kiezen voor ons? Wij investeren graag in jouw ontwikkeling en zorgen ervoor dat jij het vak van internationaal expediteur écht leert. Bij ons krijg je niet zomaar een baan, maar een functie waarin je meebouwt, leert en groeit. Jij hebt invloed op je werk, ziet het resultaat van je inzet én maakt dagelijks het verschil voor onze klanten. Ben je enthousiast geworden? Dat begrijpen we. Wij zijn vooral benieuwd naar jou! Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature? Bel gerust even met Liesbeth: 088-3190454 of mail naar hrm_NL@delmarcargo.com. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

review_candidates.title: Emergency Medicine
review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information Royal Columbian Hospital (RCH) and Eagle Ridge Hospital (ERH) are seeking full-time Emergency Physicians to join our physician group (Columbia Emergency Physicians Association). The successful applicants will have CCFP (EM) or FRCPC (EM) certification and will be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia. PALS or APLS certification within five years is also required for work within the region. ABEM certified also eligible. Previous experience in a high-volume, high-acuity Emergency Department is preferable, as is work experience with trauma and pediatric populations. ATLS or other trauma-based certification (e.g. STRUC) is highly recommended. Priority will be given to those applicants with experience and/or interest in research, quality improvement, physician leadership, education, simulation, and geriatric emergency medicine. We are looking to hire applicants who will contribute to increasing the diversity of our sites, and EDI (equity, diversity, and inclusivity) principles guide hiring practices for our departments. Compensation for a full-time Emergency Physician (~13 shifts per month) is approximately $400,000 + per year. Locum/temporary work opportunities are also available. Our collegial, cohesive group of emergency physicians now numbers approximately 70 and is one of the largest in the country. This includes physicians with a diverse array of clinical and non-clinical interests within the field of emergency medicine and beyond. Scheduling is flexible and accommodates many different physician preferences for shift distribution, and our group has established maternity/paternity leave policies, vacation and senior-member plans, along with an option for sabbaticals for interested physicians. Clinical practice between RCH and ERH is highly enjoyable given the variety provided by the two different sites and the diverse populations that present from throughout the Fraser Health region to both sites. Royal Columbian Hospital is home to two residents per year in the FRCP Emergency Medicine training program at UBC. Both sites are University of British Columbia- affiliated teaching hospitals. As a physician at RCH/ERH, you will be expected to attain a faculty appointment in the Department of Emergency Medicine, and will teach residents and UBC medical students on shift. Opportunities exist for further involvement in education in both undergraduate and postgraduate medicine at UBC. Both Eagle Ridge and Royal Columbian Hospitals are located within a 30-40-minute drive of downtown Vancouver. In addition to having access to the beautiful coastal mountains surrounding the region which boast legendary exposure to outdoor activities such as skiing, biking, climbing, hiking, and water sports, Vancouver also offers the many other cultural and artistic amenities of a cosmopolitan city. Facilities - Royal Columbian Hospital Royal Columbian Hospital is a tertiary provincial referral hospital located in New Westminster, BC. RCH is the Fraser Health site for the UBC FRCPC Emergency Medicine program. The site offers medical and surgical services, advanced diagnostics & imaging, interventional radiology, critical care, inpatient pediatrics, levels 1 & 3 obstetrics, neonatology/NICU, cardiac surgery, neurosciences, and other tertiary programs as well as 24/7 emergency services with approximately 80,000 visits annually. It is the only level-1 accredited trauma center in Fraser Health, and it also hosts the only cardiac catheterization/STEMI program within the region, making the Emergency Department (ED) one of the highest-acuity departments in Western Canada. The Royal Columbian Hospital Redevelopment is a multi-year, multi-phase project to increase the hospital's capacity and services. In February the acute tower will be open to patients and will include a new state of the art Emergency Department. The new ED will house 75 beds including a 4-bay resuscitation area, a satellite medical imaging area, and a dedicated ED procedure room. Eagle Ridge Hospital Eagle Ridge Hospital is a community hospital located in Port Moody, BC. The Emergency Department has recently undergone an extensive renovation and expansion. The site offers medical, surgical, rehabilitation, cardiac and diabetes outpatient programs, as well as 24/7 Emergency services with over 50,000 visits annually. Eagle Ridge hospital has robust hospitalist and internal medicine services which contribute to a collegial atmosphere. The site sees a large variety of ED presentations including approximately 15% pediatric visits. To Apply Interested applicants are asked to provide a CV and letter of interest when applying. Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region. People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 48,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers. We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner. Together, we are the heart of health care. Request Info Terms Compensation Compensation Type Alternative Payment Arrangement Request Info
